$comment: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12 keywords, the subset that vpt/el_layout.py and the editor page both implement: type, const, enum, required, properties, additionalProperties, items, minItems, maxItems, minimum, exclusiveMinimum, minLength, pattern, $ref to #/$defs). One home for the layout file format: the editor validates an opened or pasted file against it, the tests validate saved files against it, the Documentation tab lists its fields from it. Version 2 has the switch-light links and the rule set; a version-1 file still opens (migrated with no links and the default rule set); a version-1 file with links is refused.
title: Electrical layout of one storey (<drawing>__<storey>.electrical.json)

schema.description: Always el_layout: says what kind of file this is.

schema_version.description: Version of this format: 2 (switch-light links, rule set). Files of version 1 still open: they are migrated to 2 with no links and the default rule set; a version-1 file with links is refused.

drawing.description: Which drawing and storey the layout belongs to. Opening it on another drawing or storey is refused.

file.description: File name of the drawing (DWG/DXF) the plan file was exported from (no folder).

sha256.description: SHA-256 checksum of that drawing file (plan file drawing.sha256): the drawing's identity.

storey_label.description: Storey name, for people reading the file.

model_units_mm.description: Millimetres per model unit of the drawing (plan file drawing.mm_per_unit); null when unknown.

symbol_set.description: The symbol set the codes belong to (presets/el_symbols_at.json).

verified.description: Whether the set was checked against the standard (false for the first set).

background.description: The drawing layers that were shown when the layout was saved. Applied again when the file is opened (layers the plan does not have are left out and counted).

layers.description: Names of the shown drawing layers (empty: the plan's default layers).

hidden_layers.description: How many layers of the storey were hidden.

copied.description: When the layer choice was recorded (ISO 8601), or 'example'.

links.description: Which switch or push-button works which light: one entry per switch-light pair. Every from must be a switch-category symbol of this file and every to a symbol whose code is in that switch's connectable_to list (checked when the file is opened). Empty in version 1.

rule_set.description: The placement rule set chosen on the page (presets/el_parameters.json rules: starting or elektroplaner). Missing in version 1 (then the default).

parameters.description: The parameter file used when this layout was saved (presets/el_parameters.json): its id, version and SHA-256; edited = changed in the page's Parameters panel (then the SHA-256 is of the edited parameters as the panel writes them). Optional.

example.description: Present only in an EXAMPLE layout generated by vpt/el_examples.py (not the user's own layout): which example, the rule that chose its storey and rooms, and those rooms.

id.description: Symbol id in this layout (s1, s2, ...); links refer to it.

code.description: Symbol code in the set (e.g. SS2).

x.description: Insertion point, model x (drawing units: independent of zoom; the same coordinates as the DXF).

rotation.description: Degrees, counter-clockwise in the model (as in CAD).

room.description: Room id from the plan file the point lies in, or null (could not tell).

room_method.description: How the room was found: inside its outline; nearest label of a room without an outline (within room_label_max_m); could-not-tell.

id.description: Link id in this layout (l1, l2, ...).

from.description: Id of the switch or push-button.

to.description: Id of the light it works.
